rawToolsCapture.description:
List available ClickHouse tables in a database, including schema, comment,
row count, and column count.

Integers outside [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991] in table metadata are
returned as decimal strings.
Pagination tokens are single-use and retained for up to one hour.

database.description: The database to list tables from

like.description: Optional LIKE pattern to filter table names

not_like.description: Optional NOT LIKE pattern to exclude table names

page_token.description: Single-use token from a previous call, retained for up to one hour

page_size.description: Number of tables to return per page (default: 50, must be greater than 0)

include_detailed_columns.description:
Whether to include detailed column metadata (default: True).
When False, the columns array will be empty but create_table_query still contains
all column information. This reduces payload size for large schemas.

rawToolsCapture.name: list_tables
rawToolsCapture.title: List Tables

rawToolsCapture.description: Execute SQL queries in ClickHouse. Queries run in read-only mode by default. Set CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_WRITE_ACCESS=true to allow DDL and DML operations. Set CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_DROP=true to additionally allow destructive operations (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE, UPDATE, REPLACE TABLE/PARTITION, CREATE OR REPLACE, CLEAR COLUMN/INDEX/PROJECTION, DETACH PERMANENTLY). That gate is a best-effort accident guard, not a security boundary. Integers outside [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991] are returned as decimal strings.

rawToolsCapture.title: Run Query
